author: Дмитрий Лукашов
scope: Standalone offline Python CLI that builds an explicit allowlist snapshot of UTF-8 Markdown/text documents and returns exact normalized-word matches with source lines and SHA-256. Search includes supplied active documents only and requires unchanged indexed source bytes. No generated answer, semantic search, authority/current-version selection, model, network, API, MCP or private-core installation.
origin: New original code, documentation and invented fixtures prepared for this open-module task in November 2026 with AI assistance. No private Lookatshow core, client corpus or third-party skills copied. Python standard library only; original package files are MIT. User-supplied documents retain their own rights.
retrieval: NFKC/casefold exact word tokens; all distinct query words within one non-overlapping 12-line chunk; active-only search
source_freshness: Search/source read verifies original manifest bytes and document metadata, then every indexed file SHA-256 including archived sources; changed selection/status/version or missing/unsafe source stops retrieval. Manifest remains at the same basename under the supplied corpus root. Hashes are not authentication.

search_intent.ru: поиск по документам компании с цитатами и строками источников; локальный поиск для ИИ-агента; проверка неизменности индексированных файлов
search_intent.en: offline company document search with line citations; exact lexical evidence retrieval for AI agents; source snapshot freshness checks

suggested_description: Offline Markdown/text evidence search for AI agents: explicit corpus, exact source lines and SHA-256, active-only matches and stale-source refusal. No model or API key.
installer_support: POSIX-only explicit-prefix launcher; Windows uses the source CLI directly. Actual native-host checks are separate from CI configuration.
